supporting_quotes.exact: In an AVL tree, the heights of the two child subtrees of any node differ by not more than one; if at any time they differ by more than one, rebalancing is done to restore this property.

observations.subject: AVL tree
observations.object: not more than one; rebalancing restores on violation

claims.rationale: 引文 [0,185] 直接陈述：任意节点两棵子树高度差不超过 1（"differ by not more than one"），且一旦超过（"if at any time they differ by more than one"）即通过再平衡恢复（"rebalancing is done to restore this property"），与 claim 的两层断言（高度差≤1、超过后再平衡恢复）逐项对应；"自平衡二叉搜索树"为定义性表述，其具体性质均由引文支撑。按 EVD-001 直接证据规则判定 supported。

supporting_quotes.exact: Lookup, insertion, and deletion all take O(log n) time in both the average and worst cases, where n is the number of nodes in the tree prior to the operation.

observations.subject: lookup/insertion/deletion
observations.object: O(log n) in average and worst cases; n = nodes before operation

claims.rationale: 引文 [0,158] 逐字对应 claim：查找、插入、删除三者均 O(log n)（平均与最坏），且 n 定义为操作前树中节点数（"n is the number of nodes in the tree prior to the operation"）。claim 为引文的忠实转述，按 EVD-001 判定 supported。

supporting_quotes.exact: The AVL tree is named after its two Soviet inventors, Georgy Adelson-Velsky and Evgenii Landis, who published it in their 1962 paper "An algorithm for the organization of information". It is the first self-balancing binary search tree data structure to be invented.

observations.subject: AVL tree
observations.object: Soviet inventors Adelson-Velsky and Landis, 1962 paper; first self-balancing BST

claims.rationale: 引文 [0,264] 完整覆盖 claim 全部要素：两名苏联发明者姓名（"Georgy Adelson-Velsky and Evgenii Landis"）、1962 年论文标题（"An algorithm for the organization of information"）以及最早自平衡二叉搜索树（"It is the first..."）。claim 与引文一一对应，按 EVD-001 判定 supported。

supporting_quotes.exact: Balance factor of a node in an AVL tree is the difference between the height of the left subtree and that of the right subtree of that node.

claims.rationale: 引文 [0,140] 逐字对应 claim：平衡因子定义为左子树高度与右子树高度之差（"the difference between the height of the left subtree and that of the right subtree"）。claim 为直接转述，按 EVD-001 判定 supported。

supporting_quotes.exact: The self balancing property of an avl tree is maintained by the balance factor. The value of balance factor should always be -1, 0 or +1.

claims.rationale: 引文 [0,137] 直接对应 claim 的两个断言：自平衡性质由平衡因子维护（"The self balancing property... is maintained by the balance factor"），且平衡因子取值始终为 -1、0 或 +1（"should always be -1, 0 or +1"）。按 EVD-001 判定 supported。

supporting_quotes.exact: In rotation operation, the positions of the nodes of a subtree are interchanged.

observations.subject: rotation operation
observations.object: positions of nodes of a subtree

claims.rationale: 引文 [0,80] 逐字对应 claim：旋转操作交换子树中节点的位置（"the positions of the nodes of a subtree are interchanged"）。按 EVD-001 判定 supported。

supporting_quotes.exact: Right Right: X is rebalanced with a simple rotation rotate_Left. Left Left: X is rebalanced with a simple rotation rotate_Right (mirror-image). Right Left: X is rebalanced with a double rotation rotate_RightLeft. Left Right: X is rebalanced with a double rotation rotate_LeftRight (mirror-image).

observations.subject: four imbalance cases
observations.object: RR: rotate_Left (simple); LL: rotate_Right (simple, mirror); RL: rotate_RightLeft (double); LR: rotate_LeftRight (double, mirror)

claims.rationale: 引文 [0,296] 逐条对应 claim 的四种情形：Right Right→单旋 rotate_Left、Left Left→单旋 rotate_Right（镜像）、Right Left→双旋 rotate_RightLeft、Left Right→双旋 rotate_LeftRight（镜像），旋转类型（simple/double）与函数名均一致。按 EVD-001 判定 supported。

supporting_quotes.exact: Since with a single deletion the height of an AVL subtree cannot decrease by more than one, the temporary balance factor of a node will be in the range from −2 to +2. If the balance factor remains in the range from −1 to +1 it can be adjusted in accord with the AVL rules. If it becomes ±2 then the subtree is unbalanced and needs to be rotated.

observations.subject: single deletion
observations.object: range −2..+2; −1..+1 adjustable per AVL rules; ±2 means unbalanced, needs rotation

claims.rationale: 引文 [0,345] 完整覆盖 claim 全部断言：单次删除至多令子树高度下降 1（"cannot decrease by more than one"）、临时平衡因子范围 −2 到 +2（"in the range from −2 to +2"）、−1 到 +1 内可按 AVL 规则调整（"remains in the range from −1 to +1 it can be adjusted in accord with the AVL rules"）、±2 则失衡需旋转（"If it becomes ±2 then the subtree is unbalanced and needs to be rotated"）。按 EVD-001 判定 supported。

supporting_quotes.exact: RB insertions and deletions and AVL insertions require from zero to three tail-recursive rotations and run in amortized O(1) time, thus equally constant on average. AVL deletions requiring O(log n) rotations in the worst case are also O(1) on average.

observations.subject: AVL rotations
observations.object: insertions: 0-3 tail-recursive rotations, amortized O(1); deletions: O(log n) rotations worst case, O(1) on average

claims.rationale: 引文 [0,251] 中 AVL 相关断言与 claim 对应：AVL 插入需 0 到 3 次尾递归旋转且摊还 O(1)（"AVL insertions require from zero to three tail-recursive rotations and run in amortized O(1) time"），AVL 删除最坏 O(log n) 次旋转、平均 O(1)（"AVL deletions requiring O(log n) rotations in the worst case are also O(1) on average"）。引文额外提及 RB 的插图不影响对 AVL 断言的支撑。按 EVD-001 判定 supported。

supporting_quotes.exact: AVL trees are often compared with red–black trees because both support the same set of operations and take O(log n) time for the basic operations. For lookup-intensive applications, AVL trees are faster than red–black trees because they are more strictly balanced.

observations.subject: AVL vs red–black trees
observations.object: same operations, O(log n) basic ops; AVL faster for lookup-intensive due to stricter balancing

claims.rationale: 引文 [0,264] 逐句对应 claim：两者支持相同操作集合、基本操作同为 O(log n)（"both support the same set of operations and take O(log n) time"），查找密集型应用 AVL 更快因平衡更严格（"more strictly balanced"）。按 EVD-001 判定 supported。

supporting_quotes.exact: Indeed, every AVL tree can be colored red–black, but there are RB trees which are not AVL balanced.

observations.subject: AVL to RB coloring
observations.object: every AVL tree colorable as red–black; some RB trees not AVL balanced

claims.rationale: 引文 [0,99] 直接对应 claim 两个断言：每个 AVL 树可染成红黑树（"every AVL tree can be colored red–black"），且存在非 AVL 平衡的红黑树（"there are RB trees which are not AVL balanced"）。按 EVD-001 判定 supported。

supporting_quotes.exact: For indexing large records in databases

claims.rationale: 两条引文分别对应 claim 的两半：e31977e17e30 的 [0,39]（"For indexing large records in databases"）支撑"大记录索引"，9a0d9ef9c838 的 [0,32]（"For searching in large databases"）支撑"大型数据库检索"，两引文为同一来源（programiz-avl-tree-v2）的并列应用条目，合取完整对应 claim。按 EVD-001 判定 supported。
